text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—...Ah, Trainer. No, it's just... I got a 
little too carried away in that mock race 
earlier...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. We really must get plenty of rest 
today, shouldn't we?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case! I'm gonna make today a day 
all about doing my absolute best at 
classroom studies♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, since you're here, I'd love to have a 
strategy meeting with you, Trainer. Would 
you join me?
